spec_match.rationale: Simulates six routing scenarios and annotates rows with the values a real entry would carry — framed as simulation, with matched/final badges matching the spec's vocabulary.

interactive.rationale: Scenario buttons plus 'Simulate waterfall' rendered the annotated per-resource waterfall (screenshot-verified: race-network-wins showed matched=race..., final=network/fetch-event rows with durations).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised click-a-row routing-decision waterfall.

edge_cases.rationale: All six scenarios including both race outcomes and no-SW baseline.

references.rationale: No chromestatus link or external references on the page.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 4 pass / 2 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: selected a scenario and simulated; waterfall rows with matched/final badges and timeline bars rendered; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables; timeline bars use the accent palette.

accessibility.rationale: Scenario buttons are native, but the clickable waterfall rows are divs with no keyboard affordance and the timeline bars have no text alternative beyond the ms column.

openQuestions.title: Make waterfall rows keyboard-operable
openQuestions.detail: Row click reveals routing details but rows are not focusable; add button semantics or tabindex+key handling.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: selected 'Race: network wins' and simulated; annotated waterfall rendered with matched/final badges and per-resource durations (screenshot verified), zero console errors; the 'Paul Linlan' byline typo was fixed in place this pass (verified live).
